_doc: Lines by attitude band (hostile/cool/neutral/warm/friendly/devoted). {name} = player name. Per-character 'stories' unlock with familiarity.

hostile: "You. I've nothing to say to you."
neutral: "Brannoc. What can I do for you?"
warm: "There's the man who makes the good steel."
devoted: Their face lights up. "There you are."
"I'd trust you with my life, old man. I already do."

borin: "The deep galleries sing when there's mithril about. Folk laugh, but I heard it as a boy and I hear it now under Ironroot."
"My clan worked the Deep Ironroot until something in the dark took the night shift. Nobody went down after. I mean to."
"You paid me fair when no one else would hire a dwarf with a reputation. I won't forget it, smith."
mira: "Father wants me selling turnips. I want to see what's under the barrows."
"I can split an arrow at sixty paces. Can't split a decent blade's cost on my purse, though."
"When I come back from the Barrow Fields, I'll buy you a drink. Don't tell Father."
sigrun: "Shield-walls, cold mornings and bad ale. That's the trade."
"I lost my first company to cheap rivets. I check every buckle now. Yours hold."
"You're the only man in this village who talks to me like a soldier and not a curiosity."
elowen: "Your forge hums at a frequency most smiths never notice. Curious."
"Mithril remembers magic the way iron remembers heat. Bind it right and it never forgets."
"I came to Brindlewick for the leyline. I stayed for... other reasons."
kestra: "Don't look at my purse, smith, there's nothing in it."
"Tobin pays my debts and pretends he doesn't. I hate it."
"You never once asked what I'd done. Thank you for that."
garrick: "The Dawn keeps me; my mother keeps me honest."
"I write to Mother every week, even from the Barrow Fields. Especially from there."
"If I fall, see that Mother isn't alone. Promise me."
tomas: "Healing is easy. Paying off a dice debt — now that takes faith."
"I've buried more friends than I've healed. The odds are improving, though."
varn: "Axe broke. Again. You fix? You fix!"
"My father said orcs and smiths are brothers. Both like hitting things hard."
pip: "Every story has a smith in it somewhere, did you know? Usually off-stage."
"Kestra owes money to the Highmarsh Cobb brothers. You didn't hear it from me."
"Want to know who's angry with you? Buy me two ales and I'll tell you three names."
aldric: "Bread's up a copper. Blame the Highmarsh tolls."
"My Mira's all I have since her mother passed. Look after her, smith."
hilde: "Ale's cold, stew's hot, and nobody fights in my house."
"Adventurers come and go, smith. Mostly go. The ones you arm come back more often — I keep count."
martha: "My Garrick says you're a decent sort. I'll decide that myself."
"Mind that boy of mine when he's out there. He takes after his father: brave and stupid."
tobin: "Need shelves? Hinges? A coffin? I do all three."
"My sister is clever, which is the problem."
wenna: "I hear everything at the Wyvern, smith. Everything."
"Pip tells tales, but half of them are true."
oswin: "I'd rather bless your blades than bury their bearers."
eda: "Your shirts could use a scrub, smith. Soot everywhere."
rosalind: "Welcome to the Velvet Lantern. Discretion is the house rule."
"Adventurers tell us what they'd never tell a priest. Some of it is useful to a smith."
lysa: "You're the smith? You have kind hands for a man who hits things all day."
celeste: "Every name that sleeps here, I remember. Some of them never come back."

rumours: "{adv} is heading to {dest} soon — with gear that won't last the week, if you ask me."
"{adv} boasted that {dest} would make their fortune. They were drinking to forget the last trip."
"{adv} has more gold than sense since the last haul. Sell them something shiny."
"{adv} limps when they think nobody's looking. Their armour took the blow badly."

romance.drink_ok: You share a jug by the fire. The noise of the inn fades; for an hour it's just the two of you.
romance.court_ok: She takes your arm on the walk back. "Yes," she says, before you finish asking.
romance.propose_ok: She turns the silver band over in her fingers for a long moment. "I'm not giving up the road." — "I'd never ask you to." — "Then yes. Yes, you old fool."
romance.propose_no: "Not yet, Brannoc. Ask me again when you're sure — and when I am."

lantern.evening: The door closes. Candlelight, laughter, a cup of something warm and spiced... The night passes discreetly.
